notes: TWO cron defects behind the 2026-07-26 Discord alerts. PR #650: process-removals used the exported `ebayAuthService` SINGLETON, which carries no injected Supabase client and so fell back to the cookie-based SSR client; a cron POST has no auth cookie, so RLS on ebay_credentials (auth.uid()=user_id) matched nothing and getAccessToken() returned null EVERY run since the route was written. The eBay de-list in this cron had therefore never once worked; pre-#532 the row was still marked EXECUTED (the pha005 double-sell mechanism). Proof: a service-role caller refreshed the token at 12:30:04.932Z while the route reported 'no access token' at 12:30:05.741Z. RULE: every cron/background/script caller must use `new EbayAuthService(undefined, supabase)`. Also fixed getShopifyAlignment: `.is('shopify_products.id', null)` filters the EMBEDDED rows of a !left join, never the parents, so PostgREST returned all 749 parents child-nulled and the report claimed '749 of 749 on Shopify' AND '749 missing' simultaneously — structurally incapable of reporting zero. The anti-join must name the RELATION (`shopify_products=is.null`); !inner is NOT the fix (vacuously 0). Mismatch is now a head:true count, so a large drift can never silently cap at the old .limit(1000). PR #651: OrderPollService matched `orderItem.inventory_item_id || orderItem.id` against a map keyed by bricqer_item_id, but Bricqer order lines carry NO inventory_item_id, so it used the ORDER-LINE id against INVENTORY-item ids — order 1198 line 8652 (a 6p Plate Round 2x2) marked Gollum SOLD. 5 of 18 Bricqer removals were phantoms (lor031, bio018, adv039, spd024, ww018); low sale_price is the tell. Identity now comes from bricklink_id. Added reconciler Class C (UNBACKED ON SHOPIFY) because NO watcher joined minifig sold-ness to Shopify liveness — full-sync alignment and reconcileArchiveDrift both key off inventory_items.status, which a minifig sale never writes, and minifig-reconcile only checked eBay; 12 sold-out minifigs stayed buyable ~3 months (nothing actually oversold). Class C keys on live Bricqer stock and sums it PER SHOPIFY PRODUCT, not per sync item — hp155 has units [0,1] and is still backed; that aggregation dropped the remediation set from 12 to 11. Review fixes: a missing Bricqer client no longer flags all 28 products, proven-zero vs unverified are rendered separately, invBySet holds a list. KNOWN CONSEQUENCE: archiving the 11 left their inventory_items rows still reading LISTED (a minifig sale never updates that column), so the alignment report now correctly reports 11 LISTED items missing from Shopify. Marking them SOLD needs sold_platform/sold_date/sold_price, which feed P&L and risk double-counting revenue that already arrives as BrickLink/BrickOwl orders — deliberately NOT done, awaiting Chris. LOCAL SERVER NOT REFRESHED: /api/cron/full-sync runs against localhost:3000 (hb_crons.py), so the alignment fix does NOT reach it until apps/web is rebuilt there; the main checkout was occupied by another active session on unmerged feature/store-assessment-align-set-lookup (built 16:03 from THEIR branch), so switching it was unsafe. process-removals and minifigs/reconcile are not in hb_crons.py and are already live on Vercel. Rollback: revert 65f356cc and c26b356a — no schema change, no migration; the Shopify archives and queue-row corrections are data changes that would need separate reversal.
